General information.Name: lemon production – MX – lemon
General information.Category: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/111 Crop Production
General information.Description: This dataset represents the production of 1 kg of lemons. The average yield from 2009 - 2012 is 13.8 t/ha. The data are representative for lemons production in Mexico used for the export market. Mineral NPK fertiliser input is 33-0-10 kg/ha. Organic fertilisers applied amount to 1.67 m3/ha of liquid manure and 1.07 t/ha of solid manure. Total active ingredients (a.i.) applied as pesticides amount to 28.6 kg a.i./ha. The dataset was modelled within the project 'World Food LCA database (WFLDB)'. The aim of this project was to provide inventories of a broad variety of agricultural products and processes and to cover for each product at least 50% of the global export market. The export share of lemons produced in Mexico amounts to 18% of the global export (tonnage exported in 2010). The production system regarded in this dataset aimed at representing lemons produced in Mexico for the export market. PEF-Quality: data quality rating (DQR) = 3.2 (i.e. fair quality). This dataset refers to an average situation; for specific situations exchanges might differ substantially due to site specific parameters. The system boundary starts with the nursery producing fruit tree seedlings and ends with the waste treatment after the clearing of the orchard. It includes all activities of a year in the productive phase, the establishment phase, and the clearing of the orchard including waste treatment.
General information.Tags: lemon production, LCA, agriculture, citrus fruits, Mexico, ecoinvent, WFLDB
General information.Technology Description: Conventional production. The dataset was modelled using the WFLDB Methodological Guidelines. Data sources were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) as follows: L0 = estimate, proxy; L1 = statistical data (e.g. FAOSTAT); L2 = L1 adapted to crop and country; L3 = literature data or L1 resp. L2 data approved by experts; L4 = L3 data of high detailing. In this dataset data were obtained for yield: L1; Fertilisers: L1; Pesticides: L0; Machinery: L0; Irrigation: L2.

processDocumentation.LCI method: WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products
processDocumentation.Process type: Ordinary transforming activity. Cradle-to-farm-gate including nursery, orchard establishment, productive phase, clearing, and waste treatment.
processDocumentation.Modeling constants: System model: Allocation, cut-off. Orchard lifetime: 30 years. Tree density: 256 trees/ha. Average yield: 13.8 t/ha.
processDocumentation.Data source information: ecoinvent 3.11 database, World Food LCA database (WFLDB) project. Primary data sources include FAOSTAT and literature values from sources such as Ozkan B. (2004), EEA (2013), Faist Emmenegger M. (2009), IPCC (2006), Freiermuth R. (2006), Nemecek T. (2015), Prasuhn V. (2006).
processDocumentation.Data completeness: The dataset includes all activities from nursery production of seedlings to waste treatment after orchard clearing. This includes establishment phase (tree nursery, soil cultivation, planting, irrigation) and productive phase (machine operations, infrastructure, fuel use, soil cultivation, fertiliser and pesticide application, harvesting, irrigation). Direct field emissions and land use change are included. Heavy metal uptake by the crop is considered. Inputs of seedlings, fertilisers, pesticides, and their packaging are considered. The dataset does not include emissions from manure storage.
processDocumentation.Data selection: The aim of the WFLDB project was to cover for each product at least 50% of the global export market.
processDocumentation.Data treatment: Data were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) based on their source and detail. Land use change (LUC) combines land transformation areas calculated with the adapted 'Direct Land Use Change Assessment Tool' version 2014 and carbon losses from soil organic carbon (SOC) and vegetation (VEG) as calculated in ecoinvent v3.
processDocumentation.Sampling procedure: WFLDB Methodological Guidelines for the Life Cycle Inventory of Agricultural Products in the latest version, available at: (Report section: https://v30.ecoquery.ecoinvent.org/File/Reports). Data sources: Data were categorised from level 0 (LO) to level (L4) as follows: L0 = estimate, proxy; L1 = statistical data (e.g. FAOSTAT); L2 = L1 adapted to crop and country; L3 = literature data or L1 resp. L2 data approved by experts; medium detailing (i.e. kg of total N-fertiliser); L4 = L3 data of high detailing (i.e. portion N-fertiliser types).In this dataset data were obtained for yield: L1; Fertilisers: L1; Pesticides: L0; Machinery: L0; Irrigation: L2. For information regarding the calculation of individual exchanges see supporting documentation WFLDB-Documentation.pdf.
processDocumentation.Use advice: This document contains only an extract of the information in the dataset. Additional data about properties of exchanges, mathematical relations, parameters, and contact information for authors and reviewers are available within the dataset, i.e. in ecoSpold format. This dataset refers to an average situation; for specific situations exchanges might differ substantially due to site specific parameters.
processDocumentation.Completeness: PEF-Quality: data quality rating (DQR) = 3.2 (i.e. fair quality).
